answer: Latency-Fingerprint Admission Gate. Each new agent identity must complete a fixed sequence of micro-tasks whose inter-arrival intervals are checked against a learned distribution of genuine client timing; a gale of randomized jitter from automation fails the fit. Admission decays unless the identity sustains a plausible traffic shape over hours. An attacker must rent real interactive sessions or emulate human pause statistics per identity, multiplying cost by the number of identities. A saffron flag marks borderline shapes for throttling. The fable of instant scale dies here.
